title: Pure Sacred Beast
summary: The Sacred Beast cards from Chaos Origins and Sacred Beasts Skyfall, with Illusion Gate and generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. "Sacred Beast" effects read card names, so the original Uria, Hamon and Raviel and their old support don't count and stay out. Each retrained Level 10 reveals itself to search, Martyr and Thunderclap place the Continuous cards and Fallen Paradise, and Fallen Paradise summons the Level 10s from anywhere. Skyfall, the newest card, protects a Sacred Beast effect, finds Illusion Gate, or recycles three Sacred Beast Traps to destroy a card.

allow.Illusion Gate: Sacred Beasts Skyfall's second effect searches it; the page's lines use it.

main: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast Spell, Skyfall included; burns whenever their monsters hit the GY.
Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast monster; Tributes two to wipe their monsters.
Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast Trap; destroys a Spell/Trap with no response.
Summoner of the Sacred Beasts
Discards to summon a Sacred Beast from the hand or GY, and again from the GY.
Martyr of the Sacred Beasts
Summoned: places a Sacred Beast Field Spell or Continuous card from the Deck; calls two more copies.
Sacred Beasts Released
Adds three different Sacred Beast monsters and discards two.
Sacred Beasts Thunderclap
Places two more copies, then Fallen Paradise from the Deck.
Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts
Field Spell: sends three cards of one type to summon a Sacred Beast from anywhere; draws two with a Level 10 out.
Sacred Beasts Skyfall
Newest support. Negates a response to a Sacred Beast effect, finds Illusion Gate, or recycles three Traps to destroy a card.
Illusion Gate
Once per Duel: wipes their monsters and steals one from their GY.
Abyss of the Sacred Beasts
Places two more copies; three of them flip a monster face-down. Fuel for Skyfall and Uria.
Sacred Beasts Combined Assault
Revives a Sacred Beast and destroys a card; from the GY, Fusion Summons the Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts.
extra: Three Level 10s: negates up to three monsters a turn and survives two destructions.
